context: A chef and barista plan a menu
purpose: Teach: カクテル/斗/前夜/土佐/団長/賞味/極限/サムライ

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、新店、カクテル類、メニューに、増やしていこか、夜の客層、開拓したいんや。
lines.en: Aoi, I want to expand the cocktail menu at the new place. We should really try to pull in the night crowd.
lines.style: Warm, energetic Kansai accent. Quick, confident rhythm. Opens with her name like he's bringing her into the idea with him. Natural hand gestures implied in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。バイトの翔斗くん、料理の才能、ありそうですよね、葵で、伸ばしていきたいです。
lines.en: Yes. Shoto—the part-time kid—he's got real cooking talent. I'd love to help him develop that here at Aoi.
lines.style: Genuine and thoughtful. Slight lean forward. She's seeing potential in someone and means it. Quiet pride mixed with practical care. Eyes bright but grounded.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 新メニュー、出す前夜、めっちゃ、ワクワクするわ、葵さん、毎回、楽しみやで、本当に。
lines.en: The night before a new menu drops, I get so excited, Aoi. Honestly, every time—it's what I live for.
lines.style: Bright, boyish energy. Quick tempo. The kind of man who genuinely lights up about the work itself, not just the payoff. Leaning in like sharing a secret about himself.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。土佐の鰹、新鮮なものを、仕入れたいですね、漁師さん、ご紹介、お願いできますか?
lines.en: Yes. I want to source really fresh Tosa bonito. Could you introduce me to any fishermen you know?
lines.style: Polite but purposeful. She's asking a favour but without doubt—this is how professionals talk. Clear, measured pace. Respectful attention on his face.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 地域祭りの団長、今年も、僕、やらしてもらうことになってん、葵さん、応援、よろしく頼むわ。
lines.en: So I'm heading up the local festival again this year. Aoi, I'm counting on you to cheer me on.
lines.style: Softer than before. A small vulnerability showing. He's asking for her support quietly, under the bravado. The rhythm slows slightly, genuine.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。賞味期限管理、当店、最も、徹底している部分です、お客様の安全、第一ですから、葵で。
lines.en: Yes. Expiry-date management is something we're most strict about here. Customer safety comes first—always, at Aoi.
lines.style: Steady and clear-eyed. She's stating principle, not procedure. Quiet authority without raising her voice. Each phrase lands with care and conviction.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 料理人は、極限まで、味、追求せなあかんねん、葵さん、それが、僕の信念やで、本当に。
lines.en: A cook has to chase flavour to the absolute limit—that's my belief, Aoi. That's what I'm about.
lines.style: Intense and philosophical. Slower pace, each word weighted. He's not boasting—he's confessing a creed. His voice carries the weight of discipline and passion together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。サムライ精神のような、職人魂、当店、貫いてまいりたいです、葵で、ずっと。
lines.en: Yes. That artisan spirit—like a samurai's code—that's what we want to hold onto here at Aoi. Always.
lines.style: Soft but unshakeable. She's echoing his philosophy and making it hers. Warm, almost solemn. A closing note that settles like it was always meant to land here.
